title: Intersection component of direct-image Mayer–Vietoris comparison
statement: For a scheme morphism h:X→Y, opens U,V of Y and E∈D(O_X), choose any normalized chain map f:h_*I→J between the fixed resolutions, meaning phi_I.hom ≫ Q(f) ≫ resolutionIso_J.hom = Rh_*(resolutionIso_I.hom). Such a chain map exists by fullness of localization into K-injective J. Construct m with first component f, middle component the biproduct lift of the explicitly restriction-induced U and V maps, and third component the explicitly restriction-induced U∩V map of [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data]. Assuming the inverse-image intersection complex is K-injective, this constructed m satisfies the normalized intersection comparison identity of [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data]. No assertion is made for arbitrary morphisms of the short complexes.

proof.text: The third component of [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-map] is the explicit intersection component. Factor it using schemeMVImageComponent_factor. Cancel the target open-image computation isomorphism and apply naturality of the general open-image localization map. The source-only compatibility identity then moves the source computation to the canonical derived comparison. Normalization of f, after cancellation of the target resolution isomorphism, says Rh_*(resolutionIso_I.inv) ≫ phi_I.hom ≫ Q(f) = resolutionIso_J.inv. Apply the derived open-image functor to this equation and obtain the desired identity.

lean.statement:
theorem schemeMV_image_resolution_comparison_intersection
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (U V : Y.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (f : ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj (schemeMVResolution X E) ⟶
        schemeMVResolution Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage h).obj E))
    (hf : (RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso h.toLRSHom.toShHom
        (schemeMVResolution X E)).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f ≫
        (schemeMVResolutionIso Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage h).obj E)).hom =
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage h).map (schemeMVResolutionIso X E).hom)
    [(schemeOpenModuleImageComplex X ((h ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊓ (h ⁻¹ᵁ V))
      (schemeMVResolution X E)).IsKInjective] :
    let I := schemeMVResolution X E
    let J := schemeMVResolution Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage h).obj E)
    let m := schemeMVImageChainMap (h := h) U V I J f
    (schemeDerivedDirectImage h).map
        (((schemeMVDerivedRestriction X ((h ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊓ (h ⁻¹ᵁ V))) ⋙
            schemeDerivedDirectImage ((h ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊓ (h ⁻¹ᵁ V)).ι).map
            (schemeMVResolutionIso X E).inv ≫
          (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexComparison X ((h ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊓ (h ⁻¹ᵁ V)) I
            (schemeMVAdjunction X ((h ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊓ (h ⁻¹ᵁ V)))).inv) ≫
        (RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso h.toLRSHom.toShHom
          (schemeOpenModuleImageComplex X ((h ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊓ (h ⁻¹ᵁ V)) I)).hom ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₃ =
      (schemeMVOpenComparison h (U ⊓ V) E).hom ≫
        (((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y (U ⊓ V)) ⋙
            schemeDerivedDirectImage (U ⊓ V).ι).map
            (schemeMVResolutionIso Y ((schemeDerivedDirectImage h).obj E)).inv ≫
          (schemeOpenModuleImageComplexComparison Y (U ⊓ V) J
            (schemeMVAdjunction Y (U ⊓ V))).inv)

statement_change.old_statement: For a scheme morphism, opens U,V, and any morphism of the mapped Mayer–Vietoris complexes, the normalized direct-image comparison on the inverse-image intersection equals the normalized comparison on U intersect V.
statement_change.what: The old arbitrary-morphism claim is false: h=id, U=V=top, nonzero E and m=0 gives zero equal to an isomorphism. Replace it by an identity for the explicitly constructed restriction-induced morphism from a normalized chain map, as required by review point 4. The second reading proves the corrected identity by reduction to the source-only compatibility and open-image naturality; two strictly smaller compatibility holes remain.

old_proof.text: Apply naturality of derived open restriction and direct image comparison to the supplied complex morphism, then use the defining equations of the fixed resolution isomorphisms.
